message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to data loaded from the SQLite database or JSON files; the code only filters out NaN text values with a basic pandas mask.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from the Twitter API and scraped from external sources (snscrape, GetOldTweets3) without any checksum verification, signed URL validation, pinned revisions, or other integrity checks.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation pipeline only filters for non-empty tweets and resamples data; there are no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering mechanisms.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads NMF topic model results via `vis_helpers.get_nmf_results()` and a JSON translation set without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision to verify integrity.
No detected label distribution validation: The code is a Streamlit visualization app with data loading and display logic; there is no training loop or label distribution validation present.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No training loop exists in this code slice, and there is no backdoor or trigger detection mechanism of any kind.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries or mechanisms (e.g., Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are present anywhere in the code; the evaluation is purely descriptive/statistical visualization.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics; the code only computes and visualizes descriptive statistics directly on the full dataset.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path reads data from a SQLite DB and JSON files without any shape, type, range, or schema validation on the inputs before passing them to downstream analysis functions.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs (e.g., NMF topics from get_nmf_results) are passed directly into the analysis dict and rendered without any NaN guards, probability bounds, or sanity checks.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline is not an LLM-based system; it uses NMF topic modeling and statistical analysis, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
